name: Stormflow's tooltip quotes Unbridled Flow's real bonus (#10287)
contract: Stormflow (567555, 572861-572867) says '$?s578299[ and deals $567557s3% increased damage][]'. 567557 is a hidden aura whose effect 2 amount is 0, so players with Unbridled Flow read '0% increased damage'. The bonus applied by stormbringer_unbridled_flow is Unbridled Flow's effect 0 amount, so the streamed description quotes $578299s1 instead.

steps.label: FIX: rank 1 quotes Unbridled Flow's amount
FIX: rank 1 no longer quotes the zero amount
FIX: the top rank quotes it too
